$comment: kotlin-web-site (kotlinlang.org), the toolkit's second consumer. Drafted by project-setup.mjs on 2026-10-08 at 38512ffcb9 and completed by hand the same day from .f2c/profile.md (the fact sheet of 8 Oct 2026). Schema: projects/PROJECT-CONFIG.md in the toolkit; layout: projects/F2C-LAYOUT.md. Shape keys that differ from the first consumer: output.pageEntry index.tsx, output.sectionsRoot blocks/<page>, output.importAlias @/, output.testId <page>-<slug>, output.copy.kind plain, layout.rhythm.kind section-padding, index.shared components, annotations.hosts kotlinlang.org, contracts.scopes + @jetbrains/kotlin-web-site-ui; the grid is the ktl one (not @webteam/layout, which is installed but used by one legacy block).
name: kotlin-web-site

install.node: v22.9.0 (.nvmrc; 22.18.0 used on 8 Oct 2026, owner's call)

checks.e2e: see process.e2e — needs the dev server, not run by project-check

output.composition: pages/<page>/index.tsx (the route module lists the blocks in order)

copy.jsx: JSX text / string literals in <name>-data.tsx;   for non-breaking spaces

images.raster: with a co-located import (./images/x.webp) or a /images//... path under public/
images.vector: import x from "./x.svg" is Next's static import (an object; render x.src) — next.config.js has no svg rule; inline <svg> for small marks

links.internal: <a href> or next/link; Button href for CTAs

layout.column: ktl-layout-v2 ktl-layout--center (one per page, around the section stack)

roleSwitch.source: @media (--ktl-*-down) overrides inside the block's module css, or --rs-text-1-font-size overrides on the page wrapper

grid.$comment: ktl-layout-v2 (node_modules/@jetbrains/kotlin-web-site-ui/out/components/layout-v2/index.css, 8 Oct 2026): column 1144 (>1190) / 952 (<=1190) / 760 (<=1000) / 568 (<=808) / 424 (<=640) / 312 (<=472). The toolkit's ranges are THESE (page.json.breakpoints keys ds/tl/ts/ml/ms, decision 26 follow-up 8 Oct 2026), not rescui's four; a page's twin ranges must match this table (preflight). container = {max, pad} with content = max - 2*pad.

canon.reference: the mock's theme (page.json.theme) — one theme per landing, no switcher
canon.dark: LandingLayout default; compose/multiplatform add an inner ThemeProvider theme='dark'

versions.@webteam/layout: 3.1.1 (installed, used by one legacy block only)

textRoles.source: artifacts/contracts.json (typography 0.24.2); @jetbrains/kotlin-web-site-ui ships no .d.ts — its components are read from node_modules/@jetbrains/kotlin-web-site-ui/out/components/<name>/ directly (components.md)

shot.$comment: JetBrains Sans comes over the network from resources.jetbrains.com/storage/jetbrains-sans/ (@rescui/typography/lib/font-jb-sans-auto.css via pages/global.css) — never block that host: measure aborts on a page whose declared font did not load (8 Oct 2026, the first calibration run).

process.e2e: test/e2e/<page>.spec.ts is part of the deliverable (.ai/guidelines.md): sections in order by data-testid, one h1, anchors; run with the dev server up: yarn test:e2e test/e2e/<page>.spec.ts

calibration.$comment: Toolkit mocks with a shipped human implementation in this project — measurable with no generation. The shipped page may be a later revision than the mock (compose-multiplatform: 5 blocks shipped, 6 sections in the mock DSGN-24703; last touched 12 Mar 2026) — a check of the instrument, not an acceptance number.

annotations.source: Figma Dev Mode annotations left by designers on animated/interactive nodes
annotations.mcpShape: get_design_context: attribute data-interaction-annotations="…" on the annotated element (not the section root); absent from get_metadata
annotations.fallback: designer question, logged as an intervention
